title: Boxing a type that lacks std::error::Error
prompt: Why does returning `Box::new(my_custom_err)` cause a compiler error when my_custom_err only derives Debug?
answer: Box<dyn Error> requires the inner type to implement the `std::error::Error` trait. Deriving Debug is insufficient. You must also implement `fmt::Display` and `std::error::Error` for the custom type.
